entries.title: Context Shimming vs LoRAs as Parametric Memory Rule
entries.summary: Routes volatile or caller-scoped facts through zero-weight Teleion Fabric context shims, stabilized post-cutoff Task Object schemas into Muse Glimmer 30B LoRA adapters, and novel multi-step synthesis to frontier Muse Wonder 1.0 or Muse Spark 1.3.

schema_or_body.context_shim: 0 weight updates; volatile facts, live URIs, caller guardrails
schema_or_body.lora_parametric_memory: LoRA on Muse Glimmer 30B (4-bit QLoRA, fine-tuned by ta-amps); stable post-cutoff Task Object schemas with zero per-turn HarnessTax
schema_or_body.frontier_passthrough: Muse Wonder 1.0 / Muse Spark 1.3 through the Meta API in Standard mode (-contributor refused)

entries.title: Eranos Reusable Public-Good Nonprofit Kits
entries.summary: Catalog of reusable nonprofit Task Objects on eranosforgood.org (bilingual food pantry flyer KIT-FLYER-14, grant checklists, and impact summaries) checked on sample data by a separate key, with zero private data accepted.

schema_or_body.privacy_rule: We don't accept private information at this stage.
schema_or_body.verification: Automated checks run on sample data by a separate key; open-ended drafts undergo independent model review (drafter != reviewer).

entries.title: Teleion Fabric Meta Muse Self-Tuning Routing Matrix
